operating_notes.text: Received a variation order of ₹115.79 crore for the Mumbai Metro Line 6 project, taking the total revised contract value to ₹601.46 crore and EUR 2.68 million.
Acquired Cambium Networks' ePMP fixed wireless broadband and Enterprise Wi-Fi and cnMatrix switching businesses will operate under the Cambium Networks brand.

timeline.summary: Pradeep Kisan Khandagale, Promoter and Managing Director, disclosed 2,42,75,436 shares (67.46% of total capital) under SEBI’s Regulations 30(1), 30(2), and 31(4) as of March 31, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹109.44 Cr (+174.2% YoY), net profit ₹10.33 Cr (+145.4% YoY).
Univastu India received a variation order worth ₹115.79 crore from IRCON International for Mumbai Metro Line 6, raising the revised contract value to ₹601.46 crore.
Univastu India approved a GBP 3.9M overseas investment to incorporate Univastu Networks Limited in the UK for acquiring assets of Cambium Networks.
Univastu India's UK subsidiary completed the acquisition of Cambium Networks' ePMP fixed wireless broadband and Enterprise Wi-Fi and switching businesses on October 14, 2026.
